nodes.label: Parallel Isolated Worktree Reduction Method
nodes.rationale: Work area by area in parallel isolated git worktrees so passes never collide, one subagent per area verifying against that area's check.sh subcommand before committing, then merge every area branch into one base branch and open one PR; the result must end simpler, not denser, and a change adding indirection to save lines is a regression.
